mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply-side contraction and labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO decreases and UNRATE increases simultaneously.
